say:3:1322027002:0.text: Oh, my name is <style="highlight">Daimon</style>. This is Stitchy, my best friend.

say:5:1322027003:0.text: So, your name is Daimon! Why haven't we seen you around these parts before? Did your family just move to Whiteridge? You do know that it's more convenient to live in the town than outside, right?
say:5:1322027003:0.source_cn: 原来你叫戴蒙呀！我怎么以前都没有见过你？你们家才来白山...

say:6:1322027004:0.text: Yes, my mother and father had us move here recently. We don't really like crowded places so we didn't move into town.
say:6:1322027004:0.source_cn: 爸爸妈妈才带我搬到这里。我们……咳，我们不太喜欢人多的...

say:7:1322027005:1.text: But you can come play with us during the day. Cedartown is beautiful when the sun's out. We could build snowmen and have snowball fights all day even.

say:8:1322027006:1.text: Yeah, the grownups always worry when we go out at night. They think you're trying to kidnap us. They say you're a bad person.
say:8:1322027006:1.source_cn: 对啊。晚上出来大人们会担心，他们觉得你是坏人，要绑架我们！

say:9:1322027007:1.text: I-I'm not a bad person. Please believe me...*Cough*... I'm sorry, but I can only come out to play at night.
say:9:1322027007:1.source_cn: 啊？我……我不是坏人，请你们相信我……咳，对不起，但是...

say:10:1322027008:1.text: Because of my poor health, my mother never lets me go out alone, let alone meet new friends in town.

say:11:1322027009:1.text: *Cough*... I just don't want to be alone... so I secretly had Stitchy go out and find you all at night when Mother and Father were sleeping. Please don't be angry.
say:11:1322027009:1.source_cn: 咳咳，但是我不想一个人……所以才趁着晚上爸爸妈妈不注意...

say:12:1322027010:1.text: Oh, now I understand. Your mother sounds strict.
